summary: feat(settings): record Glean events on signin bounced and report pages
description:
Because:

* The signin bounced and report signin pages sent no Glean events.

This commit:

* Adds six login Glean events and records each beside its legacy event.
* Flushes Glean before the signin bounced support redirect.
* Adds a functional spec that checks the three view pings.

Closes FXA-15121
